message.content: This editorial illustration features a red background with yellow and black text. At the top, the yellow word "TEMPO" is prominent. Below it, a light-skinned man with short dark hair, wearing a grey collared shirt, is shown from the waist up. His torso and arms emerge from the open top of a large, bulging, tan-colored sack filled with a grainy substance. He leans forward, gripping the edges of the sack with both hands. The sack sits on a dark red surface. To the bottom left, a diagonal orange strip contains the word "START" in red, stylized, backwards letters. To the right of the man, large black text reads "BERAS ILEGAL DI PASAR LOKAL". Smaller black and yellow text below it includes the phrases "DOKUMEN IMPOR DIMANIPULASI," "BERAS VIETNAM MEMBANJIRI PASAR," and "GITA WIRJAWAN TUTUP MATA?". At the bottom right are a barcode, the price "RP 33.000", and additional small text. The top of the cover lists three headlines: "LIKA-LIKU PERBURUAN ANGGORO", "GUGAT ULANG UU MAHKAMAH KONSTITUSI", and "TEROR PENGAWAS PEMILU".
